profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Developer | Java, Ruby, Python, NodeJS, React, AWS | Available for full-time W-2 Employment | Willing to relocate |
profile.summary:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Achievement: 
- Help a Healthcare startup attract over 100k users and raise series A capital
https://www.techinasia.com/med247-series-a-funding

- Help a Real-estate startup raise a seed round
https://www.techinasia.com/cyberagent-vic-partners-pump-seed-money-proptech-startup

Specialties: Ruby on Rails, JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS, Node.js, RESTful API, GraphQL, Microservices, AWS, Docker, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, ElasticSearch, DevOps, Distributed Systems, Agile Methodologies, Healthcare Standards (FHIR, HL7), Real-Time Applications

Domain: Healthcare, Real-estate, Human Resources, Finance, E-commerce

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Engineered a multiservice system including store management, ticket system, and omnichannel chat boosting store efficiency by 30% and cutting loading time by 25%.
- Customized the Mastodon open-source system by integrating user authentication and reputation systems, amplifying user engagement, and minimizing spam.
- Built a recruitment system from scratch processing over 10,000 applications and accelerating the hiring process, reducing time-to-hire significantly.
- Guided and mentored teams of 5 to 17 members, enhancing efficiency in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and achieving more reliable software delivery.
- Automated deployment pipelines using Jenkins, GithubActions and Docker, reducing deployment times and increasing deployment frequency.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · Node.js · NestJS · Express.js · TypeScript · Next.js · Docker · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · CICD · Test-Driven Development · TDD · Full-Stack Development · AWS

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Revamped an insurance calculation project, boosting performance by 40%.
- Migrated and refactored a legacy backend, utilizing Docker for containerization, which minimized bug reports by 30% and expedited the development cycle by 20%.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless project delivery, consistently achieving project milestones.
- Enhanced existing functionalities and engineered new features to meet client requirements, resulting in more robust applications.
- Wrote and maintained tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · Node.js · NestJS · Express.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · Angular · CICD · Test-Driven Development · TDD · REST APIs · PostgreSQL · Full-Stack Development · Front-End Development

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a production system for medical examination and healthcare, enabling remote consultations for over 100,000 patients, contributing to the company’s successful Series A funding.
- Optimized system performance and scalability using Elasticsearch, GraphQL, Redis, and PostgreSQL on AWS infrastructure, improving data retrieval speeds significantly.
- Integrated PayPal and Stripe for payment processing, reducing payment-related issues by 50% and speeding up payment processing by 30%.
- Implemented and troubleshot HL7 interfaces while leveraging FHIR standards, ensuring seamless and standardized communication between healthcare systems.
- Collaborated with stakeholders to design and maintain features that improved user experience, enhanced application quality, and addressed evolving healthcare needs, ensuring client satisfaction.

positions.description:
- Delivered technology solutions that improved project timelines, resulting in accelerated deployment and increased client satisfaction.
- Constructed a document intelligence platform for financial services, increasing document processing speed by 35%.
- Implemented a cryptocurrency payment system for a dating platform using Blockchain, boosting transaction security by 40% and reducing payment processing times by 25%.
- Created real estate management and smart purchase systems applying MVC architecture to enhance user experience and increase customer engagement.
- Developed a headless CMS for a public health institute, streamlining content management processes.
